create_synchronized_sensors: create a SynchronizedSensors instance to collect time-synchronized RGB, depth, lidar, and pose data from ROS topics
run_synchronized_sensors_test: run the synchronized sensors test node that prints timestamp deltas for all sensor readings at 10Hz
get_sensor_times: get a dictionary of timestamps for rgb, depth, lidar, and pose measurements from a SynchronizedSensors instance
process_laser_scan: process a ROS LaserScan message to convert polar range and angle data into Cartesian x,y point coordinates
start_camera_subscriber: start a camera subscriber that waits for CameraInfo and returns an Image subscriber and camera info message
